name: Spicy Mapo Tofu with Ground Pork, Mushrooms, Spinach & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
6 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Slice the mushrooms and set aside.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ground pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork begins to brown, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
0.91 kg lean ground pork

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and dice tofu into ½-inch cubes; add to the pot with the pork.
Peel and mince or grate ginger; peel and mince garlic.
Add ginger and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
Add mushrooms, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot; continue to cook, stirring often, until the mushrooms begin to soften, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add most of the green onions to the pot (reserve a small amount for garnish).
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add the cornstarch slurry to the pot in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and tofu-pork mixture between bowls or plates. Garnish with reserved green onions and enjoy!
